name.en: Playful vector illustration of a girl’s legs in a cheerful pose, drawn with clean lines and vibrant flat colors. This minimal and quirky artwork captures a sense of freedom, fun, and individuality—perfect for creative projects, fashion designs, or lifestyle blogs. Ideal for use in editorial design, social media, and modern illustrations with a fun, youthful tone.
